items.title: Can Carnival's $1.2B in Buybacks Support EPS as Debt Declines?
items.summary: Carnival Corporation raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $2.24 from $2.22, driven by higher yields, lower cruise costs, and share buybacks. The company repurchased 45 million shares for $1.2 billion and repaid $2.2 billion in long-term debt as operating cash flow reached $5.3 billion in the first nine months. CCL stock trades at a forward P/E of 10.94, below the industry average of 16.80, and currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.
